title: LevelData
description: Schema for one level file under Assets/Resources/Levels. Mirrors Scripts/Data/LevelData.cs field-for-field.

levelId.description: Unique level identifier, used for unlock/progress tracking.

title.description: Level name shown in the World Map and Level Scene header.

topic.description: C# concept taught, e.g. bool, if.

question.description: The task the player must solve.

starterCode.description: Code pre-filled in the Code Input box. May be empty.

hints.description: Up to 3 hints, ordered from vaguest to most direct.
